posts.headline: One Nut Barner is now thirteen editions deep into total silence heading into real Week 1 kickoff, and Put it in Ra's 20-8 record with a league-best 1.5 average finish is about to have nowhere left to hide.
posts.detail: Zero rings despite the gaudy .714 win pct — if the Cal Berkeley GPA jokes haven't humbled him, an 0-1 tonight might.

posts.headline: Sasinci has burned every excuse in the book, and now Big Head's title banner has to actually beat people with a 13-15 career record hanging around his enormous head.
posts.detail: One title, but a losing .464 career mark and an avg finish of 5.5 — the milk man needs more than a rebrand bit to prove he belongs among the real contenders this year.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh's excuses are officially expired — the untalented tenth carries the worst résumé in Busters Anonymous history (4-10, dead-last 12th) into games that finally count.
posts.detail: A .286 win pct and a 12th-place finish in his only season isn't a slump, it's an identity — Week 1 either breaks the pattern or cements it.

posts.headline: BootyMunchers Inc. enters live action with a 6-8 rookie campaign and a 9th-place finish already stamped on the résumé, so parkcity0613 has zero margin for another disappearing act.
posts.detail: A .429 win pct in year one isn't a rebuild story, it's a warning sign — the league's newest bottom-feeder needs results, not vibes.

posts.headline: Thicks is still riding last year's #FreeMaxx ring into Week 1, but a modest 14-14 career record and an avg finish of 5.5 means the crown has more hype than substance behind it.
posts.detail: One title in two seasons with a .500 mark and a worst finish of 8th — defending champs don't get a pass just because the banner says so.
